top_signals.title: Fed Expected to Hike Rates for First Time Since 2023
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to hike interest rates for the first time in three years on Wednesday. Investors on Tuesday saw a greater than 90% chance of a quarter-point move this week and priced in another hike by the end of the year. Michael McKee has a preview. (Source: Bloomberg)
